title: Circuit boards etched by hand at the Node Beta workshop from the silicon and carbon ore a hauler already stores there (the miners' gifts to the receivers), kept in its storage for the reserve
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-22 15:54 UTC (orders.log ENT-064, block APOLLO: craft the reserve's parts docked where the goods lie rather than fly jump loops; P2 lean supply; P4 the 400 seats ask 1,500 boards). carbon_arc_circuit_etching makes 3 circuit boards from 2 silicon ore and 12 carbon ore by hand (catalog 0.732.3). The reserve (the tool stock, view=reserve, 15:48 UTC) takes 26,651 boards, holds 1,499, 23,808 short; silicon is the input that binds (2,919 held fleet-wide, no ask in any book we read, 15:52 UTC). The storage book of 15:48 UTC: two hauler receivers at Node Beta store 629 and 168 silicon ore beside 4,893 and 911 carbon ore, about 1,190 boards. Unlike craft-boards-node-beta it buys no carbon: the craft takes both inputs from the pilot's own storage, the chain of runs halving until the inputs run out (as the gold wiring routes). Rule F37: max_ships 3, each from its own store; rule F36: closes by the pull rule at the reserve's max.
